name: continual_agent_bench_v0511_kg
description: Measures continual learning and knowledge integration capabilities of agents, especially how models incorporate new knowledge over time without catastrophic forgetting. Tasks simulate sequential updates to knowledge (often via knowledge-graph style updates) and evaluate retention, adaptation, and forward performance across tasks. The benchmark is designed to stress test continual adaptation and memory in agent models.
reputation: Research-focused benchmark with limited but growing use among continual learning and agent researchers.
